name: labs/maxiv-kitscontrols__sardana-albaem
title: ALBA EM2 four-channel electrometer
intro: ALBA EM2 four-channel electrometer, adapted from maxiv-kitscontrols/sardana-albaem. It reads `identity`, `acquisition_state`, `nb_points_ready`, `current_ch1` and 11 more; sets `acquisition_mode`, `integration_time`, `nb_points`, `trigger_mode` and 5 more; runs `measure_current`, `configure_channel`, `start_acquisition`, `software_trigger` and 1 more. `measure_current`: measure current on a declared channel and return the value with its timestamp and range. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
